overview.summary:
This module defines the FastAPI application entry point for the Agentic Delivery Gateway. It creates a FastAPI instance named app with a title and version, imports a set of routers and an adapter router for composing the API, and exposes at least two asynchronous endpoint handlers: root and dev_order. The file also declares a logging filter class, RedactConsumerAuthQuery, as a specialized logging.Filter implementation intended for use within the application's logging configuration.

The module organizes application-level pieces: the FastAPI application object, routing adapters and routers, an authentication-redaction logging filter class, and two async endpoints that serve as part of the HTTP surface. The components present indicate integration points for billing, carriers, concierge, consumer, health, orders, shipments and shopify functionality via imported router modules and an adapter router from a Shopify adapter package.
